promptTemplate:
User requests SQL Server container-based guideline for huge whole-table counts with the same practical, no-service-degradation priorities as existing MySQL work. Read AGENTS.md, docs/table-count-guideline.md and calibration. You are GPT-6.1 Sol author/implementer, separate from reviewers. Do NOT start Docker/DB/measurement, delegate, run workflows, commit/push. You may inspect files and official Microsoft docs and run local syntax checks only. Owner handles actual container runs. Implement NOW, not just plan.
Create sqlserver/compose.yaml and sqlserver/lab.rb (Ruby4.0.9 controller, standard library, docker exec sqlcmd only; no external DB connections/host/DSN overrides), regeneration SQL as needed, docs/sqlserver-table-count-guideline.md Japanese, results/sqlserver/plan.json. Add a distinct mise task sqlserver-all; do not alter MySQL all, sources or old docs/proofs. New AGENTS SQL Server override governs. Container name lab-sqlserver-count; image mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2025-latest@sha256:245f6b1c8903edae52cb20fa31419cefcde1a49938bb8c3447099011fc871ca3 linux/amd64 (actual tested boot 17.0.5035.5 SQL2025CU10 Ubuntu24.04.5). Developer EULA accepted local lab; fixed public lab-only credential CountLab_Only_2026!. ARM64 Docker host is emulated, Microsoft unsupported; absolute/native performance unmeasured. 8GB Docker RAM; use4GB limit/3GBSQL memory,2CPU, no host exposed port, own named volume. Do not touch other Docker containers. Owner has a disposable container with that name live for feasibility only; owner removes it before canonical compose all.
Focused essential experiments only (not exhaustive grid): fixture-known true counts vs sys.dm_db_partition_stats (index_id IN(0,1), sum all partitions, do not doublecount secondary) vs sys.partitions and optimizer statistics rows/sys.dm_db_stats_properties, distinguishing these different mechanisms and permissions. Include empty, heap, clustered+secondary, wide80/100 columns incl encrypted ciphertext blob, partitioned rowstore, columnstore, skew/gaps; a100M thin table if feasible within bounded runtime/disk and approx750k80/100columnTDE fixture (do not pretend measured if unavailable; report notrun). Prefer few representative fixtures, not full crosses. TDE configured local certificate/masterkey only in generated container (never commit secrets/key/tabledata). Wait encryption_state=3 with bounded deadline, record server capability, plaintext client does not need key toCOUNT but server needs key; no server key means unavailable. Can use ciphertext varbinary fixture to demonstrate COUNT does not decode values. Logical row size/index and memory state; no DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS/global cache flush or autoUPDATESTATISTICS on service. Any ANALYZE equivalent only fixture preparation not recommended production.
COUNT_BIG only under preconfigured RCSI/READ COMMITTED or SNAPSHOT in dedicated lab DB; no default locking RC count on nonversioned target, NOLOCK/READPAST/TABLOCK/SERIALIZABLE or deliberate pendingDDL/blocking injections. SQL Server always Sch-S etc; cannot promise zero locks. No global prod RCSI enable advice, configuration change belongs owner separate migration. COUNT vs stats on quiet known truth, repeated small variation to observe min/max but no universal10% bound; metadata is not same as sampled optimizer stats, stale optimizer stats don't establish DMV error. sys.dm_db_partition_stats permissions SQL2022+ VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE/VIEW SECURITY DEFINITION; sys.partitions metadata visibility; RLS/execution context can make metadata and visibleCOUNT differ—do not present tenant exactness frommetadata. COUNT_BIG avoid int overflow. Columnstore delta/delete should be explicit if not exercised. Memoryoptimized, external, temporal/history, views/partition/shards have routing or defer, no unfounded support claims.
Include one small honest service-impact paired baseline vs exactcount vs metadata under natural workload, using monotonic time, timed cancellation/deadline, no excluded intentional table locks. Keep raw arrivals/outcomes/latencies/unfinished and server termination check; no sparse-windowSLO pass, no client-disconnect=cleanup claim. If sophisticated impact cannot be made reliable quickly, produce narrow explicit diagnostic and retain unavailable SLO status, do not invent assurance. Capture server logicalreads/CPU/durations separately from docker startup/CLI overhead, cache/order provenance. No universal fastest/ranking fromtinyemulatedexperiment.
Runner must implement all=blank only ownlab volume create/load/measure/integrity/checkcleanup, failclosed on invalid artifacts/method errors, raw failures retained, all results JSON with runid, seed, source file SHAs before/after, actual exit status and cleanup, image digest/id/host arch/version, observed min/max signed/absolute errors +conditions derived programmatically. Bounded time and fixture scaling explicitly recorded. Exact method budgets vs completion vs precision vs service budget vs cleanup separate. Unknown/null/permissions/timeouts never0. Do not assert planned100M or encryption done. For live writes initial/final oracle account exact committed delta or restorefixture before count. Keep size bounded (<15GB), use set-based batched generators not perrow clientloop; no huge data JSON perrow. Root may runall after code verified. Do not start database fromauthor.
Guide should be concise (~200lines), first approvedexistingexports/metadata (SQL canstilllock/getmetadata, budget), then resources-isolated copy/readablereplica correctly accounting AG readable secondary snapshot/freshness/redo contention and backups+TDEkey provisioning; no isolation feasible=>defer. Include safe snippets SETLOCK_TIMEOUT (notquerydeadline), sessioncontext, drivercommandtimeout and servercancel/rollbackverify distinct, sessionID ownership notblindkill, resourcecapsbeforemonitoring, before/during/recovery SLOheadroom; SchS/SchM vs datalocks/versionstoreundo; longsnapshot/versionstorepressure. Explain snapshotCOUNT semantics vs primarynow, noNsafe threshold, conditional TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM pagebias/zero/missing rows no10% guarantee, alternatives exact existingindex/metadata separately maintainedcounter. All numbers must later come from results/sqlserver; draft unmeasured untilowner evidence. Official Microsoftlinks for each technicalclaim. No MySQLnonlocking assumptions imported. Link newdocs from a separate sqlserver/README if needed; root will update projectREADME afterfinaldocs.
Write a small author-result JSON list files, local syntax verification, ready command, concrete known unresolved points. Do not fabricate tests or measurements. Output your result as JSON object status, files, remaining.
